title: Recap: the fast at a glance
intro: This lesson gathers the unit into a few lines: what is agreed, and what a missed fast can lead to. Nothing here is new. Where the schools differ, the earlier lessons show each position with its source.

claims.text: The core of the fast: Ramadan is fasted by the adult, sane, resident, healthy person; the fast is holding back from food, drink and intercourse from dawn until sunset; and the sick and the traveller fast the same number of days later.

consensus.location: Kitab al-Siyam, opening, and the second pillar: holding back

cards.front: In one line: what is the fast of Ramadan?
cards.back: Holding back from food, drink and intercourse from dawn until sunset, each day of the month.

cards.front: Which ayahs of al-Baqarah set out the fast of Ramadan?

claims.text: A missed or broken fast leads to one of three things: [[qada]] alone, [[fidyah]], or [[qada]] together with [[kaffarah]]. Which one applies depends on the cause, and for several causes the schools differ.

cards.front: What three things can a missed or broken fast lead to?
cards.back: [[qada]] (making the day up), [[fidyah]] (feeding a poor person), or [[qada]] with [[kaffarah]] (the heavier expiation).

check.q: Which of these is NOT one of the three things a missed fast can lead to?
options: Paying a fine to the mosque
